purpose: Atlas-hardening T6/T7 precedence must stay unbroken under the notification center. A lane that declared parked or done and then asks a question must re-alert; a declaration at or after the ask must silence the stale hook. This is attention-only — it never claims the process ended.
program: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-05-confidence-header-and-notification-center.md §3 S0-T2 and claims-first 'A parked lane that then asks something re-alerts.'

cases.name: a parked lane that asks later re-alerts
cases.claim: Parking is a declaration, not a muzzle forever. A strictly newer needsInput means a person is wanted again — blocking must return, and the center must re-alert.

cases.name: a done lane that asks later re-alerts
cases.claim: Declared done with a newer ask is the same re-alert rule. A3 forbids treating the declaration as a completion metric; it does not forbid the newer ask from reaching the center.

cases.name: parking after the ask silences the stale hook
cases.claim: If the declaration is at or after the hook, the stale ask must not stay live. Otherwise every parked lane would permanently ember-fill the badge.

cases.name: done at the same instant wins because the ask is not newer
cases.claim: Equal timestamps are not a newer ask. The declaration wins; no blocking class.

cases.name: a parked declaration never yields blocking from stalled-active alone
cases.claim: stalled-active opens the door only for an active lane. A parked lane must not be reopened by watcher-noticed idle — that would break T6/T7 and paint ember from a notice.
